cases.counterfactual_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (colors (row-at g 0))
                (marker-cell (find (lambda (iv) (member? (second iv) colors))
                                   (enumerate-list (row-at g 1))))
                (phase (first marker-cell)))
           (grid-from-fn h
                         w
                         (lambda (r c)
                           (if (< r 2)
                               (at g r c)
                               (nth colors (mod (+ phase (- r 2)) w))))))))

intermediate: The marker color's input-dependent zero-based header index.
step_a: Read the unique row-1 cell whose color occurs in row 0, then locate that marker color's unique index in the ordered header.
step_b: Use that header index as the phase offset when selecting the uniform color for every body row.
why_b_depends_on_a: The first body color and every later cycle position depend on where this input's marker color occurs in row 0; using the marker's physical column or phase zero changes the painted body.
